_meta.source: Backfilled from public/countries.json structured treaty blocks (parisAgreement, montrealProtocol, cbd, desertification) where status+date were already recorded. Source URLs below point to each convention's official ratification registry for verification; deep-linked per-country pages were not individually re-verified during this backfill. All other entries are intentionally left as unknown pending manual research — no dates were guessed or inferred from memory.
_meta.schema: {status: ratified|acceded|signed|not_party|unknown, date?: YYYY-MM-DD, source?: url, note?: string}
